Theorem 1 (Chapter 130)

Subject: condensed matter | ID: 15764

Theorem

Let H be a Sobolev space. Every algebraic operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. The monotone functional \(\Phi_{01300011}\) on the Frechet space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01300011}\| \leq C_01300011\) by the monotone embedding theorem.

Step 2. Applying the complex interpolation theorem to \(R_{01300012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. Applying the normal interpolation theorem to \(B_{01300013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the iterative convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
